hook_candidates.headline: Your AI leaks API keys. Fix it.
API keys in client chats? No.
Clients see your keys. Fix now.

caption:
Client proposals often include API keys accidentally, risking data leaks. MCP (Model Context Protocol) stops this by letting your AI connect only to approved services like Stripe without manual code.

MCP lets you create a UI to connect services securely. It logs every action, so you can audit who accessed what. You don't need to write code to enforce 'only Stripe can access client data'.

Copy this prompt to set up MCP:

"Set up secure integration with Stripe for [client name]. Only allow Stripe to access client data. Log all actions for audit."

Save this workflow for when your AI tries to share keys. Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.
